caption: The drawing depicts an ornate goblet or cup with a lid, supported by a tall pedestal base. The vessel is predominantly brown with a metallic, copper-like appearance and features a handle or latch on the lid, as well as a small decorative item next to it. The bowl beneath the lid is decorated with alternating vertical sections of red and black, framed in gold or yellow. The stem of the pedestal is bulbous with a series of red and black dots against a cream or beige background, while the base is multi-layered with octagonal black and red panels outlined in gold. The entire composition is centered on a plain, off-white background, and there are no additional objects or elements surrounding the vessel. The drawing is signed "W. Kieckhofel" in the lower right corner.
title: Baptismal Font and Stand
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
